SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Dev","3":"Ann","4":"Cara","5":"Elif","6":"Ben","7":"Finn","8":"Hana","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 98

I re-derived this from the constraints. Let Finn = f and Hana = f+1. Ann, Cara, and Elif must all sit before Finn, so f ≥ 4. Ben is two slots from Hana, so Ben = f+3 or f−1. Ben = f+3 would put Cara at f+1 or f+5, both after Finn, which breaks Cara < Finn. So Ben = f−1, and Cara = f−3. Checking f = 5 and f = 6 leads to contradictions: the remaining slots can't hold Gus and Ivo at distance 3. f = 7 gives the unique solution above.

I checked all 19 constraints against this schedule and each one holds.

The shared team note (Ben 5 / Elif 6, or Cara 5 / Elif 4) doesn't fit the constraints. For example, Ben 5 / Elif 6 forces Finn ≥ 7, so Hana ≥ 8, but Ben and Hana must be two apart, which requires Hana = 7 at most. I'd treat that note as wrong.
